substances.name: Mescaline

tolerance.full: almost immediately after ingestion

substances.addictionPotential: not habit-forming
toxicities: toxic dose is unknown
substances.summary: A psychedelic of the phenethylamine family. Found in psychedelic cacti that have long been used by peoples native to the Southwestern US and Mexico, including Peyote and San Pedro cacti, among others. Can be found as cactus pulp, as an extract from cacti, or as a synthetic substance created in a lab.
substances.effectsSummary: Before the effect sets in, nausea and/or vomiting can often occur. Hot and cold flushes as well as sweating and dizziness may also occur. These side effects usually subside after a while. The trip begins with hyperactivity and inner restlessness, followed by altered, sharpened perception and intensified colour vision. In a second phase, a more meditative concentration occurs. Users report visions and a euphoria of religious depth, the feeling of a visionary experience and the change of ego sensation as well as feelings of ego dissolution.
substances.dosageRemark: The mescaline content can vary greatly from plant to plant.
substances.generalRisks: The pharmacological effect of mescaline and the bitter taste usually lead to nausea and vomiting in the initial phase of the trip. Mescaline is toxic in high doses (from approx. 2 g) and can lead to liver damage and respiratory paralysis. Other side effects may include an increase in pulse and blood pressure, initially dry mouth, then increased salivation, pupil enlargement, increase in body temperature and a reduced feeling of hunger during the period of effect. During vomiting, users may choke on the vomit (danger of choking!).
substances.longtermRisks: The use of mescaline can trigger latent (hidden) mental disorders even with single use.
saferUse: Mescaline is not suitable as a party drug and should only be used by experienced users.

Use mescaline only if you are well prepared and in an environment where you feel comfortable. Use mescaline only in the presence of friends who are experienced users (good setting) and/or a sober person (tripsitter).
Only use mescaline when you feel good mentally and physically (good set).
You should have respect but not fear for the mescaline effect.
Mescaline should be taken on an empty stomach. Fasting before the trip may help to reduce the likelihood of nausea and vomiting.
For nausea, it helps if you take mescaline in small doses at a time.
Don't add to it if it doesn't work right away.
Let yourself go during the trip, don't try to fight the effects of mescaline. A trip sitter can help you with this.
Dextrose can help against circulatory problems.
Avoid roads and other "dangerous" places. Your orientation may be disturbed.
Drink enough water during the trip.
Mixed use of this potent substance should be avoided at all costs, as the effect can then no longer be assessed.
Plan enough time for recovery after the trip (at least 1 day)!
Mescaline trips should remain exceptional experiences and should in no case be experienced more than once a month.
People with mental problems or illnesses, people taking neuroleptics and people with circulatory and heart problems should refrain from using mescaline.

substances.name: Methamphetamine

tolerance.full: rapidly develops with prolonged and repeated use

substances.addictionPotential: extremely addictive with a high potential for abuse
substances.summary: A fairly common and very strong CNS stimulant. It is sometimes prescribed in the form of desoxyn for ADHD and severe obesity. In low doses, methamphetamine can elevate mood, increase alertness, concentration, energy and reduces appetite. At higher doses, it can induce mania, psychosis and muscle degeneration among other issues. Tolerant users may report much higher doses than new users.
substances.effectsSummary: The body's own performance drug noradrenaline is released, the simultaneous release of dopamine increases self-esteem. Since methamphetamine reaches the brain more quickly than amphetamine and the stimulating effect is stronger, it causes a stronger high and has a higher addiction potential than amphetamine. The body temperature rises, pulse and breathing are accelerated, blood pressure is increased. Hunger and the need for sleep are suppressed. The willingness to take risks is increased, the sensation of pain is suppressed, and euphoria, extreme nervousness, and an increased urge to talk ("babble flash") can occur. Methamphetamine has a pleasure-increasing and disinhibiting effect, which is why it is also used as a sex drug.
substances.generalRisks: Methamphetamine can sometimes hardly be distinguished from amphetamine, but has a much stronger effect. Short-term side effects are: tense jaw muscles, dry mouth, temperature increase, great loss of fluid, increased heart rate as well as increased blood pressure and trembling all over the body. Irritability and aggressive behaviour can also occur (especially in combination with alcohol).
substances.longtermRisks: Methamphetamine is a highly depleting substance with a very high dependence potential with psychological and physical symptoms. Aggression, depression, mental coldness and the desire for more characterise the period of regular use. Constant restlessness, sleep and circulatory disorders, paranoia and even amphetamine psychosis can occur. Weight loss, skin inflammations ("speed pimples"), tooth loss, stomach problems and cramps are also possible. In menstruating persons, the menstrual cycle may be disturbed. Snorting damages the nasal mucous membranes and nasal septum, swallowing damages the stomach mucous membranes. Chronic consumption favours brain haemorrhages and strokes with sudden paralysis. It is suspected that the use of methamphetamine (especially mixed use with MDMA) can lead to irreversible changes or damage in the brain!
saferUse: Dose low, methamphetamine is a highly potent substance!
Take vitamin C and D and minerals (iron, calcium and magnesium) with frequent use.
Eat enough after consumption to prevent weight loss.
Drink a lot (soft drinks).
Follow the safer-sniffing and safer-sex rules.
Refrain from mixed consumption. Make sure to take breaks from consumption.
Mentally ill persons, persons with high blood pressure, liver and kidney diseases, diabetics and pregnant women should not use methamphetamine.
It is better not to wear headgear (danger of overheating!).
Have your substance analysed in a drug check.

substances.name: Methcathinone
substances.effectsSummary: The effect of methcathinone is in no way directly comparable to that of the khat plant, which is traditionally consumed in Yemen, Ethiopia and Kenya. It is much more similar to the effect of other uppers such as speed. Methcathinone suppresses fatigue and hunger. It causes an increase in drive and performance, euphoria, an increased urge to talk, disinhibition, extroversion, inner restlessness and hyperactivity.
substances.dosageRemark: Snorted: 50 - 70 mg (never more than 300 mg per night!)
substances.generalRisks:
Methcathinone puts considerable strain on the heart and circulation. Since the effect of methcathinone seems rather subtle at first, there is a risk of overdose by refilling. Overdoses can cause fluttering of the heart, stomach problems, restlessness and sleep disturbances. According to reports from users, there is an increased urge to urinate, but urination can be difficult.
Some users report depressive states when coming down.
Methcathinone, like speed, can have increased impurities and high levels of extenders as it is often produced in illegal home labs.
substances.longtermRisks: There is a risk of dependence with psychological symptoms. In the case of long-term, high-dose consumption, the psychological and physical risks are similar to those of speed, cocaine or methamphetamine. In the laboratory, a so-called "craving" (urge to consume even more) could also be observed in experimental animals.
saferUse: Dose methcathinone carefully and do not add more right away.
Refrain from mixed use whenever possible. Above all, do not mix methcathinone with other drugs such as speed or cocaine.
Do not mix methcathinone with alcohol, this only increases the side effects.
Methcathinone has a very draining effect - so take breaks from using it and give yourself enough rest.
Drink water or fruit juices regularly, but not too much, as urination on methcathinone can be tedious.
Make sure you eat a balanced, healthy diet with enough vitamins and minerals.
Follow the safer sniffing rules!

substances.effectsSummary: Compared to MDMA, methylone has a stronger stimulating and less empathogenic effect. The effect is more constant, the "hangover" less than with MDMA.
substances.generalRisks: Short-term side effects are increased body temperature and heartbeat, dilated pupils and tightening of the jaw. The side effects and the (long-term) risks of methylone have hardly been researched yet.

Do not use methylone if you have heart or circulatory problems, high blood pressure, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy or mental health problems.

substances.effectsSummary:
Taking methylphenidate increases the concentration of the nerve messengers dopamine, noradrenaline and serotonin in the brain. When prescribed for ADHD, the drug is supposed to act as a filter for incoming stimuli and alleviate symptoms such as distractibility, attention deficit disorder, disorganisation and impulsivity.
However, due to its stimulating, energising and drive-enhancing properties, methylphenidate is also used as a party drug or to increase performance. Due to the increased release of dopamine, similar effects occur as with the use of cocaine.
substances.generalRisks:
If prescribed by a doctor or used as directed, sleep disturbances and irritability can often occur. Eating disorders, stomach complaints, nausea and vomiting are also known side effects.
Abusive use and higher doses can lead to seizures, cardiac arrhythmias as well as headaches and confusion.
Tolerance develops relatively quickly, which is why higher and higher doses have to be consumed. In overdose, Ritalin can trigger hallucinations.
substances.longtermRisks: It is assumed that no dependence develops with therapeutic use of Ritalin. When abusing higher doses over a longer period of time, psychological dependence may develop. With abrupt discontinuation, withdrawal symptoms such as lethargy, apathy, depression and paranoia may occur.
saferUse: If possible, do not consume methylphenidate intravenously. Due to the substances contained in the tablets, embolism (blockage of lung or brain vessels) can occur.

substances.effectsSummary:
Midazolam has a calming, relaxing, antispasmodic, anti-anxiety and sleep-inducing effect.
Taking benzodiazepines increases the effectiveness of the neurotransmitter gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) at the GABA-A receptor. This triggers sedative (calming), hypnotic, anxiolytic (anxiety-relieving), anticonvulsant (anticonvulsant) and muscle-relaxing effects in the body. Benzodiazepines have a depressant effect on the central nervous system. The flow of information in the brain between the brain cells (neurons) is thereby reduced / disturbed and feelings and perceptions are dampened.
The breakdown of the individual active ingredients of benzodiazepines in the body is age-dependent and therefore varies from person to person.
substances.generalRisks:
There is little information available on risks, toxicity, side effects and long-term consequences. Therefore, the general information on benzodiazepines applies:
When mixing with other downers (alcohol, GHB/GBL, heroin) there is a risk of respiratory paralysis!
Taking benzodiazepines can cause numerous undesirable side effects. In addition, regular and long-term use carries a very high risk of physical and psychological dependence. Benzodiazepines should only be taken as prescribed by a doctor and only for a short period of time (max. 4-6 weeks). Longer-term use should be discussed with the treating specialist. The dosages and duration of action of the individual benzodiazepines differ considerably.
Side effects of benzodiazepines may be as follows: Prolonged fatigue, gastrointestinal problems, impaired reactions, hypersensitivity reactions, headaches, dizziness, motor difficulties, visual disturbances, slowed breathing, muscle weakness, confusion, sexual dysfunction, aggression, outbursts of anger, restlessness, random movements, allergies, skin problems/rashes and speech and movement disorders. Some benzodiazepines can cause seizures in epileptics.
substances.longtermRisks:
Regular and long-term use can lead to psychological and physical dependence (very high dependence potential). Immediate discontinuation of the drug after prolonged use can lead to negative withdrawal symptoms (including dizziness, physical weakness, inner restlessness, tremors, sleep disturbances, headaches, sweating, nausea, hallucinations and depression).
In addition, seizures and memory disorders/loss and listlessness (hangover effects) can occur. In case of possible dependence, withdrawal should be discussed with a doctor beforehand and the withdrawal should be medically accompanied. It is extremely important that the dose is reduced gradually.
saferUse: If medicines are obtained on the black market or on the internet and not from a pharmacy/medical facility, the contents are unclear. Have the medicine tested for the exact ingredients in a drug check!
Do not rely on dosage information from colleagues who regularly use benzodiazepines. Due to habituation or dependence, their doses can be much higher and fatal for new users.
Blisters of counterfeits may look identical to the original packaging.

The simultaneous consumption of depressant substances such as alcohol, ketamine, GHB/GBL, nitrous oxide, opioids and/or other benzodiazepines is dangerous as there is an increased risk of vomiting and unconsciousness. The risk of suffocation is high!

tolerance.full: develops with prolonged and repeated use

substances.addictionPotential: not addictive with a low potential for abuse
toxicities: The median lethal dose at which 50% of participants die (LD50) from modafinil for human beings has never been reached
substances.summary: 口服促觉醒药，具有不同动力学的两个对映体。
substances.effectsSummary:
The mechanism of action of modafinil is not yet fully understood. It is assumed that modafinil binds to the dopamine transporter and inhibits dopamine reuptake. Unlike other stimulants such as amphetamine or methylphenidate (Ritalin®, Concerta®), which in equivalent wakefulness-promoting doses increase neuronal activity throughout the brain, modafinil acts primarily on the brain regions responsible for controlling waking, sleep, wakefulness and vigilance (sustained attention).
Modafinil thus promotes alertness (physical and mental), increases attention and motor activity. Due to its stimulating, wakefulness-promoting properties, modafinil is consumed by healthy people as a so-called "smart drug" or "cognitive enhancer".According to user reports, modafinil has a much more subtle effect than other stimulants and does not trigger comparable states of intoxication. Modafinil causes less physical restlessness and the sleep-wake rhythm is less disturbed.
A mood-lifting and euphoric effect is controversial. According to a publication of the American Food and Drug Administration (FDA), modafinil causes psychoactive and euphoric effects, whereas various studies point to the lack of a euphoric effect.
substances.dosageRemark:
The recommended daily dose when prescribed by a doctor is 200 mg at the beginning. If there is an insufficient response to this dose, a maximum daily dose of 400 mg may be administered/taken.
The long-term effect of modafinil when taken regularly and over a longer period of time has not yet been studied. If taken over a longer period of time, regular monitoring by a medical specialist is therefore recommended.
substances.generalRisks:
In 2011, the European Medicines Agency (EMA) recommended limiting the marketing authorisation for modafinil to the treatment of adults with excessive sleepiness associated with narcolepsy. Due to the possible risks and side effects, modafinil has since not been approved for other indications, for the treatment of children and adolescents, and during pregnancy and breastfeeding.
The following side effects may occur: Headache, nervousness, palpitations, abdominal pain and/or dry mouth. In addition, modafinil can impair the effectiveness of oral contraceptives! Therefore, the use of additional contraceptive methods is recommended during intake. Further risks are cardiovascular diseases such as cardiac arrhythmias, diseases of the heart muscles, cardiac insufficiency and/or high blood pressure. Furthermore, the consumption of modafinil can have an effect on the psyche and trigger hostility, aggression ,psychoses/psychotic disorders, depression, insomnia, up to delusions and/or anxiety.
Symptoms of overdose with modafinil alone or in combination with other medicines: Insomnia; central nervous symptoms (restlessness, disorientation, confusion, agitation, hallucinations); nausea, diarrhoea; palpitations, high blood pressure, chest pain, slow heartbeat.
substances.longtermRisks:
Since modafinil affects the dopamine balance in the brain, among other things, there is an increased potential for physical dependence. If modafinil is consumed for the purpose of performance enhancement and promotion of alertness with the intention of being able to achieve high performance with little sleep, there is also a risk of psychological dependence.
The long-term effect of modafinil when taken regularly and over a longer period of time has been little studied so far. If taken over a longer period of time, regular monitoring by a medical specialist is therefore recommended.
saferUse: Caution: The effectiveness of hormonal contraceptives may be impaired by the simultaneous intake of modafinil.
Side effects such as blurred vision and dizziness may impair the ability to drive or operate machinery.
Taking modafinil is not a substitute for sleep! Be sure to maintain good sleep hygiene.

If you are using modafinil for cognitive enhancement, try to think of alternative strategies to improve your memory and recall. Sleep deprivation after taking modafinil in particular can impair cognitive performance.
Take longer breaks (at least several days) between consumption.
The effect of modafinil can last up to 10 hours. Therefore, pay attention to the time of intake.
Remember to drink enough water. This can be forgotten during the effect of modafinil.

substances.name: Morphine
substances.summary: The prototypical opioid drug, a powerful analgesic with euphoric qualities, found in the seeds and wax of the plant papaver somniferum (opium poppy).  First isolated by Friedrich Sertürner in 1805, named for its sleep-inducing qualities. Do not combine with other depressants, may cause dangerous respiratory depression in overdose.
substances.effectsSummary:
Due to its strong analgesic, antitussive and psychotropic properties, morphine is used to treat severe pain in emergency and palliative care.
Due to its depressant and sedative effect, the active substance is also misused as a euphoric intoxicant. In the context of opioid agonist therapy, morphine is used as a substitute for opiate/heroin addiction.
substances.dosageRemark: When consuming for the first time, low doses should be used, as the risk of respiratory arrest is increased.
substances.generalRisks:
Gastrointestinal complaints such as constipation are common side effects after taking opiates. Nausea, vomiting, dry mouth, lack of appetite, abdominal pain, sweating, skin rashes, itching, dizziness, headaches and fatigue are other common complaints. On the psychological level, confusion, nightmares and hallucinations may occur. Rather rarely, there is a drop in blood pressure, breathing difficulties and allergic reactions.
Overdoses with morphine are life-threatening, as the substance has a strong respiratory depressant effect (worsening breathing) even in low doses, which can lead to respiratory arrest and coma. Oral consumption of 0.3 - 1.5 g and intravenous consumption of 100 mg can lead to a fatal overdose. In opioid addicts, the lethal dose can be significantly higher. An overdose is treated by taking naloxone, an opioid antagonist.
substances.longtermRisks: The consumption of morphine can lead to physical and psychological dependence after only a short time. Tolerance builds up quickly, which is why higher and higher doses have to be consumed. Strong withdrawal symptoms such as restlessness, irritability, depression, insomnia, sweating, cold shivers, vomiting, diarrhoea and painful cramps may occur. Like all opiates, morphine can lead to chronic constipation.
saferUse: Opioids are highly effective drugs that should only be used for a limited time and at best under medical supervision.
Start with a low dose and wait for the effect and tolerance before adding more. Do not exceed the maximum daily dose.

If you inject opioids, dose even more carefully, as the range between desired effect (rush) and dangerous overdose is even more difficult to assess. Avoid injecting fentanyl; the risk of overdose is particularly high. Always use new (clean and sterile) injection material! Never exchange syringes, filters, water, disinfection swabs to avoid transmission of hepatitis and HIV.
Do not rely on dosage information from colleagues who regularly use opioids. Due to habituation or dependence, their doses are much higher and can be fatal for new users.
Take longer breaks (at least several days) between consumption.
After a period of abstinence, take a much lower dose! The usual dose before the abstinence phase can otherwise quickly have life-threatening consequences.

The simultaneous consumption of depressant substances such as alcohol, ketamine, GHB/GBL, nitrous oxide, benzodiazepines and/or other opioids is dangerous as there is an increased risk of vomiting and unconsciousness. The risk of suffocation is high!
Refrain from citrus fruits (especially grapefruit) before or during consumption. The combination can lead to an increase in the effect of the opiate and/or to respiratory depression.

tolerance.full: rapidly develops with prolonged and repeated use

substances.addictionPotential: extremely addictive with a high potential for abuse
toxicities: estimated oral LD50 of 6.5 - 13 mg/kg in humans
substances.summary: A chemical found in tobacco, aubergines and tomatoes which is considered one of the most addictive drugs in existence. It is a mild stimulant, with stress relieving effects. It is widely used in the form of cigarettes, the use of which carries a high risk of causing cancer or heart issues over time. Increasingly, it is 'vaped' as a purportedly safer alternative to smoking.
substances.effectsSummary: Nicotine promotes the release of the hormone adrenaline as well as the neurotransmitters dopamine and serotonin. In low quantities, nicotine thus has a stimulating effect. Nicotine briefly and reversibly accelerates the heartbeat and causes constriction of the blood vessels. The central short-term effects include above all an increase in psychomotor performance as well as attention and memory. In higher doses, nicotine has a calming and muscle-relaxing effect; it reduces feelings of hunger, anxiety and aggression. Nicotine is responsible for addiction to tobacco products.
substances.dosageRemark: Individual and dependent on the form of consumption. The lethal dose of nicotine for adults is about 60 mg; for children and adolescents it is significantly lower.
substances.generalRisks: Reduction of the amount of oxygen in the blood and impairment of the sense of smell and taste. With regular consumption: increase in blood pressure and heart rate, increased release of adrenaline and increased activity of the gastrointestinal tract. Mostly with first or repeated consumption: drop in blood pressure, lowered body temperature, nausea and/or nausea, headache and dizziness.
substances.longtermRisks:
The accompanying substances of tobacco smoke (not nicotine) are responsible for the known health consequences of smoking such as increased risk of heart and lung diseases (asthma, chronic bronchitis, heart attack, stroke, thrombosis, lung cancer) and damage to the stomach lining (risk of stomach ulcers). Nicotine is suspected of having a cancer-promoting effect. Nicotine is one of the drugs with the highest dependence potential with psychological and physical symptoms. Withdrawal symptoms can include depression, anxiety, restlessness, insomnia and (in the long term with abstinence) weight gain. Taking medication (e.g. birth control pills) in combination with high tobacco consumption impairs blood circulation (risk of thrombosis!). People with cardiovascular problems, lung and respiratory problems (asthma, chronic bronchitis) should not use tobacco.

saferUse: Tobacco is a legal, freely available and socially accepted drug. However, this does not mean that this psychoactive substance is low-risk and harmless to health!
With e-cigarettes or vaporizers (vaporisers), there are ways to consume tobacco with less risk.
Nicotine is easily absorbed through all mucous membranes of the body. There are therefore lower-risk products such as snuff, chewing tobacco or nicotine gum.
If you shoot yourself, make sure you use good filtering methods.
For people with cardiovascular problems, risk of heart attack, lung and respiratory problems (asthma, bronchitis), it is recommended not to consume tobacco or to consume only small amounts.

Women who use hormonal contraception run an increased risk of circulatory disorders, thromboses, varicose veins and thus heart attacks, strokes or pulmonary embolisms (blockage of blood vessels in the lungs) when they use tobacco. Women over 30 are particularly at risk.
Smoking during pregnancy is generally not advisable, as the toxins in tobacco smoke enter the bloodstream of the foetus via the placenta.
Always press out your cigarettes well. There is a risk of fire!
Do not eat tobacco. If tobacco or tobacco dissolved in water is accidentally swallowed (especially by children), an emergency call should be made immediately. There is a danger to life!

substances.effectsSummary:
Oxazepam has a calming, relaxing, antispasmodic, anti-anxiety and sleep-inducing effect.
Taking benzodiazepines increases the effectiveness of the neurotransmitter gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) at the GABA-A receptor. This triggers sedative (calming), hypnotic, anxiolytic (anxiety-relieving), anticonvulsant (anticonvulsant) and muscle-relaxing effects in the body. Benzodiazepines have a depressant effect on the central nervous system. The flow of information in the brain between the brain cells (neurons) is thereby reduced / disturbed and feelings and perceptions are dampened.
The breakdown of the individual active ingredients of benzodiazepines in the body is age-dependent and therefore varies from person to person.
substances.generalRisks:
There is little information available on risks, toxicity, side effects and long-term consequences. Therefore, the general information on benzodiazepines applies:
When mixing with other downers (alcohol, GHB/GBL, heroin) there is a risk of respiratory paralysis!
Taking benzodiazepines can cause numerous undesirable side effects. In addition, regular and long-term use carries a very high risk of physical and psychological dependence. Benzodiazepines should only be taken as prescribed by a doctor and only for a short period of time (max. 4-6 weeks). Longer-term use should be discussed with the treating specialist. The dosages and duration of action of the individual benzodiazepines differ considerably.
Side effects of benzodiazepines may be as follows: Prolonged fatigue, gastrointestinal problems, impaired reactions, hypersensitivity reactions, headaches, dizziness, motor difficulties, visual disturbances, slowed breathing, muscle weakness, confusion, sexual dysfunction, aggression, outbursts of anger, restlessness, random movements, allergies, skin problems/rashes and speech and movement disorders. Some benzodiazepines can cause seizures in epileptics.
substances.longtermRisks:
Regular and long-term use can lead to psychological and physical dependence (very high dependence potential). Immediate discontinuation of the drug after prolonged use can lead to negative withdrawal symptoms (including dizziness, physical weakness, inner restlessness, tremors, sleep disturbances, headaches, sweating, nausea, hallucinations and depression).
In addition, seizures and memory disorders/loss and listlessness (hangover effects) can occur. In case of possible dependence, withdrawal should be discussed with a doctor beforehand and the withdrawal should be medically accompanied. It is extremely important that the dose is reduced gradually.
saferUse: If medicines are obtained on the black market or on the internet and not from a pharmacy/medical facility, the contents are unclear. Have the medicine tested for the exact ingredients in a drug check!
Do not rely on dosage information from colleagues who regularly use benzodiazepines. Due to habituation or dependence, their doses can be much higher and fatal for new users.
Blisters of counterfeits may look identical to the original packaging.

The simultaneous consumption of depressant substances such as alcohol, ketamine, GHB/GBL, nitrous oxide, opioids and/or other benzodiazepines is dangerous as there is an increased risk of vomiting and unconsciousness. The risk of suffocation is high!

substances.summary: A semisynthetic opioid analgesic developed in 1917, prescribed primarily for pain management. It has become extremely popular as a recreational drug in some areas, and carries a high potential for addiction. Reported as being a little more 'stimulating' than other opioids.
substances.effectsSummary: Oxycodone has analgesic, depressant, antianxiety, cough suppressant and psychotropic properties. More intense dreams may also occur. Due to its relaxing and euphoric properties, it is used as a recreational drug, and is said to be more stimulating and mood-lifting than other opioids.
substances.generalRisks:
Very common side effects, as with all opioids, are constipation and constriction of the pupils. Drowsiness, dizziness, headache, itching, muscle twitching, sleep disturbances and mood swings are also to be expected. In women, menstruation may also be absent.
Other opioid-typical side effects such as hallucinations, confusion, vomiting and nausea are less common with oxycodone.
Overdoses with oxycodone are life-threatening, as the substance has a strong respiratory depressant effect even in low doses when abused, which can lead to respiratory arrest and coma. For opioid addicts, the lethal dose can be much higher. An overdose is treated by taking naloxone, an opioid antagonist.
substances.longtermRisks: The consumption of oxycodone leads to physical and psychological dependence after a short time, even more quickly than with morphine. Tolerance builds up, which is why higher and higher doses have to be consumed. Strong withdrawal symptoms such as restlessness, irritability, depression, insomnia, sweating, cold shivers, vomiting, diarrhoea and painful cramps may occur.
saferUse: Opioids are highly effective drugs that should only be used for a limited time and at best under medical supervision.
Start with a low dose and wait for the effect and tolerance before adding more. Do not exceed the maximum daily dose.

If you inject opioids, dose even more carefully, as the range between desired effect (rush) and dangerous overdose is even more difficult to assess. Avoid injecting fentanyl; the risk of overdose is particularly high. Always use new (clean and sterile) injection material! Never exchange syringes, filters, water, disinfection swabs to avoid transmission of hepatitis and HIV.
Do not rely on dosage information from colleagues who regularly use opioids. Due to habituation or dependence, their doses are much higher and can be fatal for new users.
Take longer breaks (at least several days) between consumption.
After a period of abstinence, take a much lower dose! The usual dose before the abstinence phase can otherwise quickly have life-threatening consequences.

The simultaneous consumption of depressant substances such as alcohol, ketamine, GHB/GBL, nitrous oxide, benzodiazepines and/or other opioids is dangerous as there is an increased risk of vomiting and unconsciousness. The risk of suffocation is high!
Refrain from citrus fruits (especially grapefruit) before or during consumption. The combination can lead to an increase in the effect of the opiate and/or to respiratory depression.

substances.dosageRemark:
Average dosages of dried* mushrooms:
Pointed cone bald: light 0.5-0.8 g, medium to strong 1.0-max. 2 g
Hawaiian: light 0.3-0.5 g, medium to strong 0.5-max. 1 g
Mexican: light 0.5-1.5 g, medium to strong 1.5-max. 5 g
*for fresh mushrooms approx. ten times this amount.
x mg psilocybin is stored in each fully developed fruit body. So the number of species is more relevant than the quantity.
substances.generalRisks:
The pupils dilate, pulse and blood pressure change, increase in body temperature (sweating), breathing difficulties and palpitations may occur. Occasionally, nausea may occur. Balance disorders, an altered sense of space-time, confusion and anxiety are also possible; panic attacks may occur in the case of stimulus overload.
The use of psilocybin can trigger latent (hidden) mental disorders.
When picking mushrooms in nature, there is a risk of confusion due to deadly doppelgangers!
saferUse: Consume mushrooms only in good mental and physical condition (set).
Do not consume mushrooms alone, but with someone you trust.
Pay attention to the setting. A stress-free environment is important, preferably in nature. Mushrooms are not party drugs!
Consume mushrooms only after a light meal; it is best to eat very little for 6 to 8 hours to avoid nausea and other unpleasant side effects. Chew mushrooms well!
Use dried mushrooms if possible; wash raw mushrooms well before eating.
In delicate moments during the trip: let yourself go, try not to fight the effect of the mushrooms.
Avoid mixed consumption, never consume mushrooms together with alcohol or medication!
Avoid roads and other "dangerous" places, your orientation may be disturbed.
In case of panic attacks or horror trips: see General Information under Emergency.
After the trip, allow yourself plenty of rest and recovery, at least the day after, to be able to process the experience.

substances.summary: A synthetic opioid analgesic, tramadol is used to treat moderate pain and can be considered a medium-strength opioid. Tramadol also has the unusual effect of being a serotonin releasing agent and a serotonin reuptake inhibitor, and as a consequence should not be taken in excess due to the risk of serotonin syndrome. Risk of seizures above 300mg doses.
substances.effectsSummary:
Analgesic, anxiety-relieving, euphoric, mood-lifting, causes a general feeling of contentment.
The human body has its own pain-relieving system. The endogenous substance endorphin ensures that pain messages are sent to the human brain in a reduced form by docking to certain receptors in the human body. The active ingredient tramadol has a similar mode of action in that the active ingredient attaches to neurotransmitter docking sites (opioid receptors) and transmits a signal to the brain, which subsequently triggers pain relief. In addition, tramadol inhibits the reuptake of certain nerve messengers (noradrenaline and serotonin), which in turn increases the amount of free messengers in the tissue and supports the analgesic effect.
substances.dosageRemark: When consuming for the first time, low doses should be used, as the risk of respiratory arrest is increased.
substances.generalRisks:
Adverse side effects may include: headache, malaise/nausea, vomiting, dry mouth, dizziness, drowsiness, constipation, drowsiness, circulatory problems (palpitations, fainting spells, etc.).
In higher doses, seizures, speech disorders, paraesthesias (unpleasant bodily sensations, e.g. parts of the body falling asleep), tremor (muscle tremor), coordination disorders and circulatory collapse may occur. Hallucinations, confusion, delirium, anxiety, sleep disorders and nightmares can also be triggered.
substances.longtermRisks:
Tramadol has a low dependence potential with moderate use. However, regular and long-term use can lead to psychological and physical dependence. Immediate discontinuation of the drug after prolonged use can lead to negative withdrawal symptoms, which may manifest as dizziness, physical weakness, inner restlessness, tremors, sleep disturbances, headaches, sweating, nausea, hallucinations and depression.
Prolonged use can lead to general mood changes, changes in decision-making behaviour or perceptual and reaction disorders.
saferUse: Opioids are highly effective drugs that should only be used for a limited time and at best under medical supervision.
Start with a low dose and wait for the effect and tolerance before adding more. Do not exceed the maximum daily dose.

If you inject opioids, dose even more carefully, as the range between desired effect (rush) and dangerous overdose is even more difficult to assess. Avoid injecting fentanyl; the risk of overdose is particularly high. Always use new (clean and sterile) injection material! Never exchange syringes, filters, water, disinfection swabs to avoid transmission of hepatitis and HIV.
Do not rely on dosage information from colleagues who regularly use opioids. Due to habituation or dependence, their doses are much higher and can be fatal for new users.
Take longer breaks (at least several days) between consumption.
After a period of abstinence, take a much lower dose! The usual dose before the abstinence phase can otherwise quickly have life-threatening consequences.

The simultaneous consumption of depressant substances such as alcohol, ketamine, GHB/GBL, nitrous oxide, benzodiazepines and/or other opioids is dangerous as there is an increased risk of vomiting and unconsciousness. The risk of suffocation is high!
Refrain from citrus fruits (especially grapefruit) before or during consumption. The combination can lead to an increase in the effect of the opiate and/or to respiratory depression.

indications: 在稳定、有症状、射血分数不高于 35% 的慢性心衰成人中，且窦性心率至少 70 次/分、已用最大耐受量 β 受体阻滞剂或存在其禁忌时，降低心衰恶化住院风险。
contraindications: 急性失代偿性心衰、显著低血压、病态窦房结综合征或特定房室传导阻滞、显著心动过缓、严重肝损害、起搏器依赖及合用强 CYP3A4 抑制剂。

contraindications: 支气管哮喘、窦性心动过缓、二度以上房室传导阻滞、心源性休克和明显心力衰竭。
majorWarnings: 突然停药可加重心绞痛或诱发心肌梗死；可掩盖低血糖症状并增加支气管痉挛风险，肾功能损害时需减少剂量。
majorInteractions: 维拉帕米、地尔硫䓬、地高辛和儿茶酚胺耗竭药可叠加心动过缓或传导抑制；抗糖尿病药需加强血糖监测。
monitoring: 监测心率、血压、肾功能、心衰和支气管痉挛；停药时通常用 1–2 周逐渐减量。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 一般成人消除半衰期

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 常用每日 40–80 mg，可按反应增加；高血压最高常需 240–320 mg

contraindications: 不得静脉或其他胃肠外给药；强 CYP3A4 抑制剂合用为禁忌。

monitoring: 监测血压、神经状态、吞咽能力和肝功能；尽可能整粒吞服，不能整粒吞咽时须使用标签规定的胶囊内容物方法。

substances.summary: 供吞服的雌二醇片剂。

indications: 缓解绝经相关血管舒缩症状、治疗外阴及阴道萎缩和某些低雌激素状态。
该美国说明书也包括特定肿瘤的姑息治疗与适当人群的骨质疏松预防。
contraindications: 妊娠、原因不明的生殖道出血、雌激素依赖性肿瘤、既往或活动性静脉血栓、近期动脉血栓事件、肝病或过敏。已知、疑似或既往乳腺癌也属禁忌，特定转移性乳腺癌的姑息治疗除外。
majorWarnings: 全身雌激素可增加血栓和卒中风险。有子宫时，单用雌激素可增加子宫内膜癌风险。
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 诱导剂或抑制剂可能改变雌激素暴露。
monitoring: 评估异常出血，定期复核用药。合用甲状腺激素替代治疗时检查甲状腺功能。

mechanisms: 通过雌激素受体发挥作用。

notes: 吞服后经历肝脏首过代谢，雌二醇与雌酮可相互转化。

indications: 中枢性性早熟
contraindications: 妊娠，或对 GnRH、GnRH 激动剂或制剂成分过敏。
majorWarnings: 初期可出现激素短暂升高。也有精神症状、惊厥、严重皮肤反应和儿童颅内压升高的报告。
majorInteractions: 该说明书未报告正式药代相互作用研究。使用可能降低惊厥阈值的合并用药时需关注惊厥风险。
monitoring: 按制剂说明书检查 LH 或性激素，随访身高和骨龄。

mechanisms: 持续用药可降低垂体对 GnRH 的反应，减少促性腺激素分泌。

notes: 此达峰时间来自成人使用月制剂的数据。

tmax.basis: 成人单次肌内注射平均约值，检测含主要无活性代谢物

monitoring: 按儿童中枢性性早熟方案随访 LH、FSH 和相关性激素，并评估身高增长与骨龄。

indications: 美国 3.6 mg 植入剂涵盖特定前列腺癌、子宫内膜异位症、消融前内膜变薄及特定晚期乳腺癌。10.8 mg 标签适应证按其说明书。

monitoring: 按适应证随访，关注血糖、骨健康及心电图和电解质风险。

mechanisms: 初期激动 GnRH 受体，持续暴露后抑制垂体促性腺激素。

monitoring: 监测体重、血糖、血脂、血压及运动症状。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 第 5–95 百分位范围，均值约 30 小时

monitoring: 随访体重、血糖、血脂、异常运动及冲动控制变化。

substances.name: Amisulpride

drugClass: 苯甲酰胺类抗精神病药
indications: 英国说明书用于有阳性或阴性症状的急性或慢性精神分裂症。
contraindications: 过敏、泌乳素依赖性肿瘤、嗜铬细胞瘤、青春期前儿童或正在使用左旋多巴。

monitoring: 根据肾功能评估剂量，结合风险评估心电图和电解质，随访运动症状、泌乳素相关症状和血糖。

majorWarnings: 关注泌乳素升高、异常运动、QT 延长及恶性综合征。
majorInteractions: 多巴胺激动药可相互拮抗，其他延长 QT 药物增加风险。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

substances.name: Perphenazine
substances.summary: 所引产品为奋乃静普通口服片。

indications: 精神分裂症和成人严重恶心呕吐。

substances.name: Fluphenazine
substances.summary: 此处剂量对应盐酸氟奋乃静口服片。癸酸氟奋乃静长效注射剂有独立给药方案。

indications: 用于精神病性障碍的症状控制。
contraindications: 对本品过敏，疑似或确诊皮质下脑损害，昏迷或严重中枢抑制，或有血液病及肝损害等。
majorWarnings: 可出现锥体外系反应、迟发性运动障碍、低血压和恶性综合征。老年痴呆相关精神病患者死亡风险增加。
majorInteractions: 酒精、阿片及其他中枢抑制剂可叠加镇静及呼吸风险。
monitoring: 随访异常运动、血压及疗效，按风险评估血象和肝功能。

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 按说明书分次口服，给药间隔 6–8 小时

substances.summary: 心律风险限制使用的口服抗精神病药。

substances.name: Droperidol
substances.summary: 所引美国制剂为氟哌利多注射剂，具有镇静和止吐作用。

indications: 用于降低手术或诊断操作相关恶心呕吐发生率，限其他治疗无效或不适合时。
contraindications: 已知或疑似 QT 延长，包括先天性长 QT 综合征，或对本药过敏。
majorWarnings: 可发生严重室性心律失常、低血压及镇静。

monitoring: 给药前检查十二导联心电图，按美国说明书在给药后继续心电监测，并监测血压、呼吸和意识。

substances.name: Cariprazine
substances.summary: 口服胶囊，具有活性代谢物，剂量调整的影响可持续数周。

indications: 美国说明书列有精神分裂症、双相 I 型躁狂或混合发作、成人双相抑郁及成人重性抑郁障碍的抗抑郁药辅助治疗。各用途有年龄限制。
contraindications: 既往对卡利拉嗪过敏。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

tmax.basis: 单次口服后母药血浆约值

indications: 在密切医疗随访下治疗抑郁症状。
contraindications: 过敏、MAOI 合用及规定停药期、急性心肌梗死恢复期等。
majorWarnings: 可发生心动过速、体位性低血压、抗胆碱不良反应和过量毒性。
majorInteractions: 其他抗胆碱药及 CYP2D6 抑制剂增加相关风险。
monitoring: 随访情绪、血压和心脏症状，老年患者尤其注意心血管风险。

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 分三次或四次口服，从较低量逐步调整

substances.name: Isocarboxazid
substances.summary: 口服非选择性 MAOI，处方需核对饮食及合并药物。

indications: 用于其他抗抑郁药疗效不满意的抑郁患者。
contraindications: 过敏、心脑血管疾病或高血压、嗜铬细胞瘤、肝病及严重肾功能损害。多种药物合用及换药期禁用。
majorWarnings: 可发生高血压危象、体位性低血压、血清素综合征及肝损伤。
majorInteractions: 富含酪胺的食物、拟交感药及部分抗抑郁药可造成严重相互作用。
monitoring: 检查血压、肝功能、情绪及饮食和药物相互作用。

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日两次口服，按耐受逐步调整

substances.name: Selegiline
substances.summary: 此处为用于抑郁症的司来吉兰透皮贴剂。口服抗帕金森产品另查。

indications: 成人重性抑郁障碍。
contraindications: 嗜铬细胞瘤、12 岁以下及多种禁忌合用药或换药间隔。
majorWarnings: 关注血清素综合征、高血压危象、低血压及贴敷反应。
majorInteractions: 其他抗抑郁药及特定阿片等禁忌合用，较高规格贴剂需按标签限制酪胺。
monitoring: 随访血压、情绪、皮肤反应及相互作用，避免外部热源。

notes: 透皮给药减少首过代谢。标签将静脉给药后母药及三种代谢物的平均半衰期合并报告为 18–25 小时。

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日更换一片，移除旧贴片并轮换部位

substances.name: Esketamine
substances.summary: 此处资料对应艾司氯胺酮鼻喷剂。鼻喷产品的剂量和药代按该制剂记录。

indications: 美国所引鼻喷剂用于成人难治性抑郁症。也可与口服抗抑郁药联用，治疗伴急性自杀意念或行为的成人重性抑郁障碍中的抑郁症状。
contraindications: 动脉瘤性血管病、动静脉畸形、脑出血病史或对艾司氯胺酮、氯胺酮或辅料过敏。
majorWarnings: 可能发生镇静、分离症状、呼吸抑制及血压升高。具有滥用风险。
majorInteractions: 中枢抑制剂可增强镇静，精神兴奋剂和 MAOI 可增加血压升高风险。
monitoring: 在医疗监督下给药，给药前后测血压，监测呼吸和镇静至少 2 小时，临床稳定后离开。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 鼻喷后终末消除范围

doseUseReferences.population: 符合说明书条件的成人
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 前 4 周每周两次，在医疗机构监督下鼻喷

substances.name: Lithium Carbonate
substances.summary: 碳酸锂口服胶囊。给药量以碳酸锂质量计，血液监测测量锂离子浓度。

indications: 美国说明书用于双相 I 型躁狂及混合发作的急性治疗和维持治疗。
contraindications: 对胶囊辅料过敏。严重肾功能不全时按所引说明书避免使用。
majorWarnings: 治疗浓度与中毒浓度接近。脱水、钠平衡变化和肾功能下降可增加中毒风险。长期治疗也需关注肾脏及甲状腺。
majorInteractions: 利尿剂、NSAID 和肾素–血管紧张素系统拮抗剂可升高血锂浓度。
monitoring: 基线查肾功能、电解质及甲状腺功能。按说明书采集距上次口服约 12 小时的血锂，随访肾和甲状腺功能。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 锂的消除半衰期约值

doseUseReferences.indication: 双相 I 型躁狂或混合发作
doseUseReferences.amountText: 起始每次 300 mg 碳酸锂
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日三次口服，依据血锂及临床反应调整

substances.name: Valproate
substances.summary: 所引口服液含丙戊酸钠，强度按丙戊酸当量。

indications: 标签所列局灶和失神等癫痫发作。
contraindications: 显著肝病、规定的 POLG 线粒体病、尿素循环障碍或相关过敏。
majorWarnings: 有肝毒性、胰腺炎、胎儿损伤、高氨及血小板减少风险。
majorInteractions: 可升高拉莫三嗪暴露，碳青霉烯类可降低丙戊酸浓度。
monitoring: 监测肝功能、血象及临床反应，必要时测血药及血氨。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 口服丙戊酸单药范围

doseUseReferences.population: 成人及 10 岁以上患者
doseUseReferences.amountText: 起始每日 10–15 mg/kg（丙戊酸当量）
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 口服，日总量超过 250 mg 时分次，按标签滴定

substances.name: Divalproex
substances.summary: 所引美国制剂为双丙戊酸钠缓释片，标示剂量按丙戊酸当量。

drugClass: 丙戊酸类抗癫痫药及心境稳定剂
indications: 用于躁狂或混合发作、部分癫痫发作以及偏头痛预防。
contraindications: 肝病或显著肝功能异常、规定的 POLG 相关线粒体病、尿素循环障碍或过敏。偏头痛预防时妊娠及未采取有效避孕的可生育女性禁用。
majorWarnings: 有严重肝损伤、胰腺炎和胎儿损害风险，也可能出现血小板减少及高氨血症。
majorInteractions: 可升高拉莫三嗪暴露。碳青霉烯类可大幅降低丙戊酸浓度。
monitoring: 基线及治疗早期监测肝功能，随访血象和凝血指标，有适应证时测血药浓度，意识异常时考虑查血氨。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 丙戊酸口服单药时的平均终末半衰期范围

doseUseReferences.population: 符合说明书条件的成人
doseUseReferences.amountText: 首周每日 500 mg（以丙戊酸计）
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 缓释片每日一次口服，后续按说明书调整

substances.name: Carbamazepine
substances.summary: 所引药品是普通卡马西平片。连续给药可诱导自身代谢。

indications: 美国所引标签用于某些癫痫发作及三叉神经痛。
contraindications: 骨髓抑制病史、对卡马西平或相关三环化合物过敏、与奈法唑酮合用。说明书要求在开始治疗前留出至少 14 天的 MAOI 停药间隔。
majorWarnings: 可出现严重皮肤反应、骨髓抑制、肝损伤及低钠血症。某些遗传背景的人群需评估 HLA-B*15:02。
majorInteractions: 酶诱导可降低多种药物及部分激素避孕药暴露。某些 CYP3A4 抑制剂可升高卡马西平浓度。
monitoring: 基线和治疗期间关注血象、肝功能和血钠。必要时测血药浓度。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 重复用药后，初期约 25–65 小时

doseUseReferences.population: 成人及 12 岁以上儿童
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日两次口服，后续按发作控制和耐受调整

substances.name: Oxcarbazepine
substances.summary: 所引产品为口服混悬液，主要活性来自单羟基代谢物 MHD。

indications: 局灶起始性发作，单药或辅助治疗的年龄范围按标签。
contraindications: 对奥卡西平、成分或醋酸艾司利卡西平过敏。
majorWarnings: 可出现低钠血症、严重皮疹、DRESS、头晕和步态不稳。
majorInteractions: 可降低部分激素避孕药暴露，卡马西平等可降低 MHD 浓度。
monitoring: 随访血钠、发作控制、皮疹及神经不良反应，按肾功能核对用量。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 活性代谢物 MHD，母药约 2 小时

doseUseReferences.indication: 局灶起始性发作辅助治疗
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 混悬液分两次口服

substances.name: Lamotrigine
substances.summary: 所引制剂为拉莫三嗪口崩片。起始和加量方案随合用药变化。

drugClass: 抗癫痫药及心境稳定剂
indications: 用于所引说明书规定的部分癫痫治疗和双相 I 型障碍维持治疗。
contraindications: 既往对拉莫三嗪或制剂成分过敏。
majorWarnings: 可出现危及生命的严重皮疹。合用丙戊酸、起始量过高或加量过快可增加风险。
majorInteractions: 丙戊酸减慢清除。部分抗癫痫药和含雌激素避孕药可降低拉莫三嗪暴露。
monitoring: 随访皮疹、发热、黏膜症状、疗效和耐受。中断后重新开始前按说明书复核滴定方案。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 未合用其他药物的健康志愿者多次给药均值

doseUseReferences.indication: 双相 I 型障碍维持治疗
doseUseReferences.population: 成人，未合用丙戊酸及所列诱导剂
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日一次口服，按相互作用和说明书逐步加量

substances.name: Hydroxyzine
substances.summary: 所引英国薄膜衣片含盐酸羟嗪，可产生镇静作用。

drugClass: 第一代 H1 抗组胺药
indications: 辅助控制成人焦虑，并用于荨麻疹或某些皮炎相关瘙痒。
contraindications: 对成分过敏、已知 QT 延长或有说明书列出的心律危险因素等情况禁用。
majorWarnings: 可出现嗜睡、抗胆碱不良反应、QT 延长和尖端扭转型室速。
majorInteractions: 禁忌与已知延长 QT 间期或可致尖端扭转型室速的药物合用。酒精及镇静药可加重中枢抑制。
monitoring: 评估心律风险及合并用药，随访嗜睡、疗效及心悸或晕厥。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 说明书所引对照受试者平均终末消除约值

doseUseReferences.population: 成人，老年及肝肾功能异常患者另行评估
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 夜间口服，按需要及耐受调整

substances.name: Nitrazepam
substances.summary: 所引制剂为硝西泮口服片，次日可持续镇静。

indications: 日间镇静可以接受时，短期治疗严重失眠。
contraindications: 过敏、严重呼吸或肝功能不全、重症肌无力、睡眠呼吸暂停及儿童等。
majorWarnings: 可出现嗜睡、遗忘、跌倒、依赖和戒断。
majorInteractions: 阿片、酒精及其他中枢抑制剂增加镇静和呼吸风险。
monitoring: 随访睡眠、次日警觉性、呼吸和依赖风险，并安排逐步停药。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 血浆均值

doseUseReferences.population: 成人，老年或体弱者减量
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 睡前口服

substances.name: Estazolam
substances.summary: 具有镇静作用的口服苯二氮䓬类药物。

indications: 短期治疗入睡困难、夜间频繁觉醒或早醒所致失眠。
contraindications: 对本药或苯二氮䓬类过敏，或合用酮康唑、伊曲康唑。
majorWarnings: 可出现嗜睡、运动协调受损、依赖及戒断。突然停药可引发严重戒断。
majorInteractions: 阿片、酒精及其他中枢抑制剂可增加严重镇静与呼吸抑制风险。
monitoring: 随访睡眠、日间警觉性、呼吸及依赖风险，症状持续时复评失眠原因。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 说明书所载消除范围

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 睡前口服

substances.name: Lormetazepam
substances.summary: 此处资料对应氯甲西泮口服片。

indications: 短期治疗严重影响日常生活或引起明显痛苦的失眠。
contraindications: 严重呼吸功能不全、睡眠呼吸暂停、重症肌无力、严重肝功能衰竭或对苯二氮䓬类及成分过敏。
majorWarnings: 可出现嗜睡、共济失调、跌倒、依赖及戒断。
majorInteractions: 酒精、阿片及其他中枢抑制剂可加重镇静和呼吸抑制。
monitoring: 随访睡眠、次日警觉性和呼吸，评估跌倒和依赖风险，开始前商定停药方案。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 口服后终末相约值

doseUseReferences.population: 成人，老年患者宜从较低剂量开始
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 睡前口服

substances.name: Flurazepam
substances.summary: 所引口服胶囊含盐酸氟西泮，其活性代谢物可持续较长时间。

indications: 用于伴入睡困难、频繁夜醒或早醒的失眠。
contraindications: 对氟西泮或其他苯二氮䓬类药物过敏。
majorWarnings: 可发生次日嗜睡、步态不稳及跌倒，连续用药可能蓄积。也有依赖和戒断风险。
majorInteractions: 阿片、酒精和其他中枢抑制剂可加重镇静及呼吸抑制。
monitoring: 随访睡眠、次日警觉性、跌倒、呼吸和依赖风险，老年患者尤其需评估。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 活性代谢物 N1-去烷基氟西泮的消除范围

doseUseReferences.amountText: 起始 15 mg 盐酸氟西泮
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 临睡前口服

substances.name: Clorazepate
substances.summary: 口服二钾盐，给药后迅速转化为活性代谢物去甲地西泮。

indications: 用于焦虑障碍或短期缓解焦虑、局灶性发作的辅助治疗及急性酒精戒断。
contraindications: 对本品过敏或急性窄角型青光眼。
majorWarnings: 可出现镇静、运动协调障碍及依赖。快速减量或骤停可引起戒断和惊厥。
majorInteractions: 阿片类、酒精及其他中枢抑制剂可加重镇静和呼吸抑制。
monitoring: 复评疗效、镇静、呼吸和依赖风险，长期治疗时结合说明书考虑血象和肝功能检查。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 活性代谢物去甲地西泮的表观血浆消除

doseUseReferences.amountText: 所引说明书每日起始 7.5–15 mg 二钾盐
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 口服，按反应及耐受调整

substances.name: Prazepam
substances.summary: 长效抗焦虑药，重复给药可蓄积活性代谢物。

indications: 短期治疗严重焦虑。
contraindications: 苯二氮䓬过敏、重症肌无力、严重呼吸或肝功能不全及睡眠呼吸暂停。
majorWarnings: 关注镇静、跌倒、呼吸抑制及依赖戒断。
majorInteractions: 酒精、阿片和其他中枢抑制剂增加镇静及呼吸风险。
monitoring: 复评焦虑、警觉性及续用必要性，并逐步减量。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 主要活性代谢物 norprazepam，多次给药后均值

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 一次或分次口服，按反应调整

substances.name: Clobazam
substances.summary: 所引美国口服混悬液是单成分氯巴占制剂。

indications: 2 岁及以上患者 Lennox–Gastaut 综合征相关发作的辅助治疗。
contraindications: 既往对氯巴占或制剂成分过敏。
majorWarnings: 可出现嗜睡、依赖及戒断，严重皮肤反应包括 SJS/TEN 和 DRESS。
majorInteractions: 与阿片或其他中枢抑制剂同用可加重镇静和呼吸抑制。CYP2C19 抑制剂可升高活性代谢物暴露。
monitoring: 随访癫痫发作、镇静、呼吸、皮疹和过敏症状，调量时注意蓄积。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 母药均值范围，活性代谢物约 71–82 小时

doseUseReferences.population: 2 岁及以上且体重不超过 30 kg，特殊人群另行核对
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 口服混悬液每日一次，调量按说明书执行

substances.name: Tofisopam
substances.summary: 所引制剂为托非索泮 50 mg 口服片。

drugClass: 苯二氮䓬类相关抗焦虑药
indications: 伴紧张、焦虑、自主神经症状的心理或躯体疾病，以及酒精戒断相关自主神经症状。
contraindications: 相关过敏、失代偿性呼吸功能不全、睡眠呼吸暂停或昏迷病史，以及合用他克莫司、西罗莫司或环孢素。
majorWarnings: 可出现激越、失眠、胃肠不适及呼吸抑制，癫痫者可能诱发发作。
majorInteractions: 上述免疫抑制剂禁忌合用，阿片及其他中枢抑制剂可增加呼吸风险。
monitoring: 随访焦虑、激越及呼吸，核对肝肾功能和合用药。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 生物半衰期

doseUseReferences.indication: 标签所列焦虑相关状态
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日口服 1–3 次，按临床反应调整

substances.name: Zaleplon
substances.summary: 所引产品为扎来普隆口服胶囊。

indications: 失眠短期治疗，主要研究入睡时间。
contraindications: 既往本药引起复杂睡眠行为或相关过敏。
majorWarnings: 可能发生嗜睡、异常睡眠行为、依赖和戒断。
majorInteractions: 酒精及其他中枢抑制剂增加镇静与呼吸风险。
monitoring: 随访睡眠及异常行为，持续失眠需复评。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 终末相约值

doseUseReferences.population: 成人，老年或肝功能异常另有减量
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 临睡前口服单次

substances.name: Ramelteon
substances.summary: 所引制剂是雷美替胺普通口服片。

indications: 以入睡困难为特点的失眠。
contraindications: 既往用药后血管性水肿，或合用氟伏沙明。
majorWarnings: 关注嗜睡、异常睡眠行为、过敏及情绪变化。
majorInteractions: 氟伏沙明显著升高暴露，避免酒精，核对其他 CYP 抑制剂。
monitoring: 复评睡眠及次日清醒程度，严重肝功能损害时避免使用。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 母药范围，活性代谢物较长

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 睡前 30 分钟内口服，避免随高脂餐服用

substances.name: Suvorexant
substances.summary: 口服催眠药。

indications: 入睡或睡眠维持困难。
contraindications: 发作性睡病。
majorWarnings: 可发生次日警觉性受损、复杂睡眠行为及睡眠瘫痪。
majorInteractions: 强 CYP3A 抑制剂显著升高暴露，酒精和中枢抑制剂增加镇静。
monitoring: 随访睡眠、日间嗜睡、异常行为及情绪。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

doseUseReferences.population: 成人，无需相互作用减量
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每晚最多一次，睡前 30 分钟内服，距起床至少 7 小时

substances.name: Lemborexant
substances.summary: 口服催眠药，通过抑制觉醒信号作用。

indications: 用于成人入睡困难或睡眠维持困难。
contraindications: 发作性睡病。
majorWarnings: 可能影响次日警觉性，也可能出现睡眠瘫痪、复杂睡眠行为或抑郁加重。
majorInteractions: 避免与中强度 CYP3A 抑制剂或诱导剂合用。酒精和其他中枢抑制剂可叠加镇静。
monitoring: 随访睡眠、次日嗜睡、异常睡眠行为及情绪。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 有效半衰期，5 mg 对应 17 小时，10 mg 对应 19 小时

doseUseReferences.population: 成人，肝功能异常或相互作用时另行核对
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 临睡前口服一次，距计划起床至少 7 小时

substances.name: Daridorexant
substances.summary: 口服催眠药，通过抑制觉醒信号作用。

indications: 成人入睡困难或睡眠维持困难所致的失眠。
contraindications: 发作性睡病或对达利雷生及制剂成分过敏。
majorWarnings: 可能影响次日警觉性，或出现睡眠瘫痪、复杂睡眠行为及抑郁加重。
majorInteractions: 避免与强 CYP3A4 抑制剂或中强度 CYP3A4 诱导剂合用。酒精和中枢抑制剂可叠加镇静。
monitoring: 随访睡眠改善、日间嗜睡和异常睡眠行为。存在呼吸功能损害时评估风险。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 终末消除约值

doseUseReferences.population: 成人，肝功能及相互作用需另行核对
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 临睡前 30 分钟内口服一次，距计划起床至少 7 小时

substances.name: Brotizolam
substances.summary: 所引荷兰片剂为每片 0.25 mg。

drugClass: 苯二氮䓬受体镇静催眠药
indications: 短期治疗严重影响生活的失眠。
contraindications: 过敏、重症肌无力、严重呼吸抑制、睡眠呼吸暂停、严重肝功能损害及未满 18 岁。
majorWarnings: 有镇静、记忆受损、依赖及戒断风险。
majorInteractions: 酒精、阿片及其他中枢抑制剂可加重镇静或呼吸抑制，CYP3A4 抑制剂可影响暴露。
monitoring: 复评睡眠、次日警觉性和呼吸风险。说明书通常将疗程限制在两周内。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

tmax.basis: 吞服 0.25 mg 后平均约 45 分钟

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 健康受试者血浆消除

doseUseReferences.population: 成人，老年人另有较低起始量
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 空腹临睡前口服一次

substances.name: Quazepam
substances.summary: 口服催眠药，具有较长时间存在的活性代谢物。

indications: 入睡困难、频繁夜醒或早醒相关失眠。
contraindications: 对夸西泮或苯二氮䓬类过敏。
majorWarnings: 关注次日镇静、跌倒、依赖及戒断。
majorInteractions: 阿片、酒精及其他中枢抑制剂可增加严重镇静与呼吸风险。
monitoring: 复评睡眠、清醒度、呼吸和依赖，逐渐停药。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 母药均值，另一活性代谢物可更长

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 睡前口服

substances.name: Loprazolam
substances.summary: 所引资料为 1 mg 口服片。

indications: 短期治疗严重失眠，包括入睡困难或频繁夜醒。
contraindications: 苯二氮䓬类过敏、急性肺或严重呼吸功能不全、重症肌无力、睡眠呼吸暂停，以及说明书列出的精神疾病情境。
majorWarnings: 可出现嗜睡、遗忘、跌倒、依赖和戒断。
majorInteractions: 酒精、阿片及其他中枢抑制剂可增强镇静或呼吸抑制。
monitoring: 随访睡眠、次日警觉性、呼吸及依赖风险，开始前确定停药策略。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 单次 1 mg，HPLC/GC 测定，5 人均值

doseUseReferences.population: 成人，体弱者另有较低起始量
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 睡前口服

substances.name: Chloral Hydrate
substances.summary: 所引英国制剂为 143 mg/5 mL 口服溶液。

indications: 其他治疗失败时短期治疗影响日常活动的重度失眠。儿童用途限符合条件的神经发育障碍患者，由专科评估。
contraindications: 过敏、严重肝肾损害、严重心脏病、活动性胃炎或食管炎、胃十二指肠溃疡或穿孔，以及易发生急性卟啉病发作。
majorWarnings: 关注过度镇静、呼吸抑制、心律失常和依赖。所引疗程最长两周。
majorInteractions: 酒精及其他中枢抑制剂可加重镇静。应核对延长 QT 间期的合并用药。
monitoring: 评估警觉程度、呼吸及心脏风险，重复疗程前需专科复评。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 三氯乙醇血浆消除，非原形药

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 143 mg/5 mL 溶液，睡前 15–30 分钟口服一次

substances.name: Clomethiazole
substances.summary: 所引软胶囊每粒含 192 mg 氯美噻唑游离碱。

indications: 用于老年患者躁动、短期治疗老年重度失眠，以及在严密监护下治疗酒精戒断症状。
contraindications: 对成分过敏或急性肺功能不全。
majorWarnings: 可导致呼吸抑制、过度镇静及依赖。老年患者及肝功能损害患者暴露可能增加。
majorInteractions: 与酒精或其他中枢抑制剂同用可显著增强抑制作用。
monitoring: 随访警觉性、呼吸、治疗反应和依赖风险。

doseUseReferences.amountText: 192–384 mg 游离碱，先试较低量
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 睡前口服 1–2 粒 192 mg 胶囊

substances.name: Meprobamate
substances.summary: 口服中枢抑制性抗焦虑药。

drugClass: 氨基甲酸酯类抗焦虑药
indications: 焦虑障碍或短期缓解焦虑症状。
contraindications: 急性间歇性卟啉病，或对甲丙氨酯及相关化合物过敏。
majorWarnings: 可引起嗜睡、依赖及严重戒断，过量可造成昏迷和循环衰竭。
majorInteractions: 酒精、阿片和其他中枢抑制剂可增加抑制作用。
monitoring: 随访警觉性、依赖及合用药，长期用药后逐渐停药。

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 分三次或四次口服

substances.name: Tasimelteon
substances.summary: 所引胶囊与口服混悬液不能直接替换。

indications: 成人非 24 小时睡眠觉醒节律障碍。
contraindications: 所引美国标签未列禁忌。
majorWarnings: 可出现嗜睡及警觉性下降。
majorInteractions: 避免强 CYP1A2 抑制剂和强 CYP3A4 诱导剂。
monitoring: 随访睡眠节律和日间警觉性，保持每天同一用药时间。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 母药平均终末值

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日同一时间睡前 1 小时口服，空腹

substances.name: Atomoxetine
substances.summary: 所引口服胶囊含盐酸托莫西汀，强度以托莫西汀计。

drugClass: 非兴奋剂类 ADHD 药
indications: 用于 ADHD。
contraindications: 过敏、与 MAOI 合用或处于相应停药间隔、窄角型青光眼、嗜铬细胞瘤或其病史，以及血压或心率升高会加重的严重心血管疾病。
majorWarnings: 儿童及青少年需关注自杀意念。还可能出现血压升高、心率加快或少见严重肝损伤。
majorInteractions: 氟西汀和帕罗西汀等强 CYP2D6 抑制剂可增加暴露。与升压药同用需谨慎。
monitoring: 治疗前、调量后和定期测血压及心率，随访情绪、儿童生长及肝损伤症状。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: CYP2D6 正常代谢人群平均值，慢代谢者约 21.6 小时

doseUseReferences.population: 成人，强 CYP2D6 抑制剂合用或慢代谢者按说明书调整
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 口服，可早晨一次或分早晨和下午晚些时候服用

substances.name: Guanfacine
substances.summary: 此处资料对应胍法辛缓释片。即释片和缓释片的暴露及用量不同。

drugClass: 中枢 α2A 肾上腺素能受体激动剂
indications: 所引美国缓释片用于 ADHD，可单独使用或辅助兴奋剂治疗。
contraindications: 对胍法辛或制剂成分过敏。
majorWarnings: 可能低血压、心动过缓、晕厥及嗜睡。突然停药可能导致反跳性高血压。
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 抑制剂或诱导剂可改变暴露，镇静或降压药可加重相应不良反应。
monitoring: 开始前、加量后及治疗期间测血压和心率，并随访镇静。停药时逐步减量。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

tmax.basis: ADHD 儿童及青少年服缓释片后约值

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 早晨或晚上口服一次，整片吞服，避免与高脂餐同服

substances.name: Dexmethylphenidate
substances.summary: 哌甲酯的右旋苏式异构体。此处资料对应盐酸右哌甲酯即释片。

indications: 用于 ADHD。美国 Focalin 片的用量资料适用于儿童。
contraindications: 对哌甲酯或制剂成分过敏，或合用 MAOI 及停药后 14 天内。
majorWarnings: 有滥用和成瘾风险，可升高血压及心率，并可能影响儿童生长。关注新发精神症状。
majorInteractions: MAOI 可引发高血压危象。右哌甲酯可降低部分降压药效果。
monitoring: 治疗前核对心脏病和抽动病史，随访血压、心率、身高、体重和精神症状。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 即释片口服后平均终末消除约 2.2 小时

doseUseReferences.population: 6 岁及以上，未使用哌甲酯的儿童
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日两次口服，两次至少间隔 4 小时

substances.name: Viloxazine
substances.summary: 所引美国制剂为盐酸维洛沙嗪缓释胶囊。

drugClass: 非兴奋剂类 ADHD 药
indications: 成人及 6 岁以上儿童 ADHD。
contraindications: MAOI 合用或规定停药期，以及敏感或治疗范围窄的 CYP1A2 底物合用。
majorWarnings: 关注自杀意念、心率血压升高、嗜睡和躁狂激活。
majorInteractions: 抑制 CYP1A2，禁忌合用规定底物，其他药物需核对。
monitoring: 治疗前后检查血压心率，随访情绪、睡眠和疗效。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 母药平均值

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日一次口服，按标签每周调整

substances.name: Pitolisant
substances.summary: 所引片剂强度按替洛利生计，含盐酸盐。

drugClass: 组胺 H3 受体调节剂
indications: 6 岁及以上发作性睡病患者的日间嗜睡或猝倒。
contraindications: 过敏或严重肝功能损害。
majorWarnings: 可延长 QT，并可能发生失眠和焦虑。
majorInteractions: CYP2D6 抑制剂、CYP3A4 诱导剂和其他延长 QT 药物需核对，可能降低激素避孕效果。
monitoring: 按肝肾功能及相互作用核对剂量，随访觉醒和心律风险。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 单次 35.6 mg 后中位数

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 醒来后口服一次，随后按标签滴定

substances.name: Solriamfetol
substances.summary: 所引片剂按索利氨酯计量。

indications: 成人发作性睡病或阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停相关嗜睡。
contraindications: MAOI 合用或停药后 14 天内。
majorWarnings: 可升高血压和心率，或出现焦虑、失眠及精神症状。
majorInteractions: 其他升压药及多巴胺相关药物需谨慎核对。
monitoring: 开始前控制血压，随访血压心率、觉醒和精神症状，并按肾功能调整。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 表观平均终末消除

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 醒来后口服一次

substances.name: Donepezil
substances.summary: 所引口服片含盐酸多奈哌齐。

indications: 阿尔茨海默病相关痴呆。
contraindications: 对多奈哌齐或哌啶衍生物过敏。
majorWarnings: 可能出现恶心、腹泻、心动过缓或晕厥，也需关注胃肠道出血及体重下降。
majorInteractions: 可能与抗胆碱药作用相反，并增强某些胆碱能药和琥珀胆碱类肌松药的作用。
monitoring: 随访认知及日常功能、体重、胃肠耐受和心率，评估晕厥或消化道出血症状。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 口服后消除约值

doseUseReferences.indication: 阿尔茨海默病相关痴呆
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日一次，于晚上临睡前口服

substances.name: Rivastigmine
substances.summary: 所引胶囊含酒石酸卡巴拉汀，强度按卡巴拉汀计。

indications: 阿尔茨海默病或帕金森病相关的轻至中度痴呆。
contraindications: 相关过敏，或既往贴剂反应提示过敏性接触性皮炎而未经排除过敏。
majorWarnings: 可发生恶心呕吐、体重下降、心动过缓及严重皮肤反应。
majorInteractions: 抗胆碱药可相互拮抗，β 阻滞剂可增加心动过缓风险。
monitoring: 随访认知、体重、进食、胃肠耐受和心率。中断后按标签重新滴定。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 血浆约值，酶抑制时间较长

doseUseReferences.indication: 轻至中度阿尔茨海默病痴呆
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日两次随餐口服，按耐受滴定

substances.name: Naltrexone
substances.summary: 所引口服片含盐酸纳曲酮。开始前需确认阿片使用情况。

indications: 用于酒精依赖及阻断外源性阿片作用，结合完整治疗计划。
contraindications: 正在使用阿片、存在阿片依赖或急性戒断、纳洛酮激发试验未通过、尿阿片检测阳性或过敏。
majorWarnings: 可诱发严重戒断，肝损伤和阿片过量风险需评估。
majorInteractions: 阻断阿片镇痛药及某些含阿片的止咳止泻药作用。
monitoring: 核对无阿片间隔和肝脏情况，随访情绪、复饮和阿片暴露。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 母药均值，活性代谢物 6β-纳曲醇约 13 小时

doseUseReferences.population: 已按标签确认阿片相关禁忌的成人
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日一次口服

substances.name: Acamprosate
substances.summary: 所引产品为阿坎酸钙肠溶片，剂量按钙盐标示。

indications: 用于已戒酒的酒精依赖患者维持戒酒，结合心理和社会支持。
contraindications: 对产品过敏或严重肾功能损害（肌酐清除率不超过 30 mL/min）。
majorWarnings: 腹泻较常见。关注抑郁、自杀意念及行为。
majorInteractions: 所引说明书未见与地西泮或双硫仑有临床意义的药代相互作用。
monitoring: 按肾功能核对剂量，随访饮酒情况、胃肠道耐受及情绪。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 肠溶片口服后终末消除约值

doseUseReferences.population: 肾功能无需减量的成人
doseUseReferences.amountText: 每次 666 mg 阿坎酸钙
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日三次口服

substances.name: Varenicline
substances.summary: 所引产品为伐尼克兰普通片。

indications: 辅助戒烟。
contraindications: 既往严重过敏或与本药相关的严重皮肤反应。
majorWarnings: 可出现恶心、异常梦境、情绪行为变化及少见惊厥。
majorInteractions: 酒精反应可能改变，戒烟本身可改变某些合用药物需要量。
monitoring: 随访戒烟反应、情绪和耐受，按肾功能核对剂量。

substances.name: Disulfiram
substances.summary: 通过造成乙醛蓄积增强饮酒后不适反应，用于辅助维持戒酒。

indications: 用于有戒酒意愿的部分慢性酒精依赖患者，配合支持性和心理治疗。
contraindications: 近期使用甲硝唑、副醛、酒精或含酒精制剂，严重心肌疾病或冠状动脉闭塞、精神病性障碍，或对双硫仑及相关秋兰姆衍生物过敏。
majorWarnings: 饮酒可引起低血压、呼吸困难及其他严重反应。停药后长达 14 天仍可发生反应。还需关注肝炎和神经病变。
majorInteractions: 核对隐性酒精来源。可升高苯妥英暴露，并影响口服抗凝药效果。
monitoring: 核对戒酒时间、基线肝功能及早期复查，随访肝损伤和神经症状。

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 口服，结合耐受及治疗反应调整

substances.name: Nalmefene
substances.summary: 所引美国制剂为纳美芬注射液，区别于减酒用途的口服片。

indications: 逆转阿片引起的效应，包括术后或过量相关呼吸抑制。
contraindications: 对该产品过敏。
majorWarnings: 可诱发急性戒断及心血管不良反应。呼吸抑制仍可复发。
majorInteractions: 拮抗阿片镇痛及呼吸抑制作用。
monitoring: 先保障气道及通气，再按临床反应给药，监测呼吸、血压和戒断。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 静脉 1 mg 后终末消除均值
